body: The input account diagnoses a breakdown in shared mental models and proposes a structural fix. However, this view risks treating the symptom (ambiguity) rather than the cause (mismatched standards). Verbal agreements fail not only because they are unwritten, but because 'clean' is subjective. A static system enforces assignment without resolving definition. The avoiding friend's behavior may signal exhaustion from enforcing their standards against others, not just stress from negotiation. A rival approach suggests negotiating 'finished states' before assigning tasks. Re-engagement should invite the avoiding friend to define 'enough' rather than design the tracking system, reducing the cognitive load placed on them.
